items.title: Ametria Dock interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 4, 2019
items.q: I could go to Eddie's Attic and I could sing a — who's my favorite — a Joni Mitchell song.

ctx.x: Okay. So a lot I work on that for my clients. And so what we do is we sit down and we choose a set list for the types of songs. So there’s a lot of work that goes in. We have to think about where you’re going to perform, where you want to perform, so the types of clubs that you’re performing at. We have an Open Mic club that is more singer/ songwriter feel and so it’s more guitar and piano driven and so the types of songs that they sing at this particular club is more singer/songwriter as opposed to another club…

Do your students learn about the etiquette of relating to accompanist or a band, like I’ve sung now you do a gesture to the piano player, you got it, that kind of thing, when to come back in on the bridge.
